race.description: Tab Venue Mode Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: AZZUCCA (8) finds it hard to win with just one success from 14 starts but she was sound when sixth over 1080m at Canberra Acton, beaten 4.5 lengths, and she has the ability to test this field. ZOUCAT (4) comes south from Grafton where he was beaten 5 lengths last time. That followed a win at Port Macquarie at the previous outing which does rate well against these. GEOSTORM (5) produced a good run two starts back to finish second but was below par last time when out of the placings at Canberra Acton over 1080m. It doesn't get any easier but on his best form he is one of the key runners. VINARI (9) is a progressive type who should figure in the finish again.
